judgments.reason: The OSF record (osf.io/ktv7m) is the original EEGEyeNet deposit by the same authors, from which this BIDS dataset is derived; it is another deposit of the same data.
The EEGEyeNet paper by Kastrati, Płomecka et al. introduces the EEGEyeNet dataset, which this BIDS subset comes from (same authors, same name). It is the dataset's data paper.
judgments.paper_title: EEGEyeNet: a Simultaneous Electroencephalography and Eye-tracking Dataset and Benchmark for Eye Movement Prediction
